note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Returned unopposed. Owen McGeough: no party label printed in 1936. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Crossmaglen, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1936, printed 'N': Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1936, p. 4 ("Local Government Nominations: Armagh County Council"); Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1936, p. 6 ("The Elections")).
